hojum_effekt.name: Hojum installed electrical capacity
hojum_effekt.note: Plant specification checked in 2026; not annual production or municipally available capacity.

hojum_fallhojd.name: Hojum head
hojum_fallhojd.note: Hydraulic head, not a water level in RH 2000.

hojum_vattenforing.name: Hojum specified discharge
hojum_vattenforing.note: Plant specification, not observed annual mean river flow.

olidan_vattenforing.name: Olidan specified discharge
olidan_vattenforing.note: No conversion to annual generation has been made.

olidan_driftstart.name: First electricity supply from Olidan
olidan_driftstart.note: Electricity was supplied to industry and railways.

fjarrvarme_trabransle.name: Wood fuel share of district heat

fjarrvarme_spillvarme.name: Waste heat share of district heat
fjarrvarme_spillvarme.note: 2025 production mix; denominator differs from energy input.

fjarrvarme_spillvarme_mwh.name: Waste heat used in district heating

fjarrvarme_klimatintensitet.name: Emissions intensity of supplied district heat
fjarrvarme_klimatintensitet.note: Reported utility value; fossil-free does not mean zero life-cycle emissions.

lan_temperatur_referens.name: Historical county mean annual temperature
lan_temperatur_referens.note: County mean, not a local weather station.

lan_temperaturokning_rcp45.name: County warming under RCP4.5
lan_temperaturokning_rcp45.note: Approximately 3 degrees against 1961–1990. A 2015 scenario, not a 2126 forecast.

lan_temperaturokning_rcp85.name: County warming under RCP8.5
lan_temperaturokning_rcp85.note: Approximately 5 degrees against 1961–1990. Regional scenario, not a municipal temperature measurement.

vattenverk_planerad_drift.name: Planned commissioning of new waterworks
vattenverk_planerad_drift.note: Planned around 2030, not guaranteed completion. Lake Vänern becomes the new raw water source.

kanal_langd.name: Length of Trollhätte Canal
kanal_langd.note: The entire fairway, not only the municipal section.

kanal_nivaskillnad.name: Total canal level difference
kanal_nivaskillnad.note: Lake Vänern to the sea; not sea level at central Trollhättan.

slussar_trollhattan.name: Locks in the present Trollhättan section
slussar_trollhattan.note: Four of the canal’s six locks.

kanal_farledsdjup.name: Specified minimum fairway depth
kanal_farledsdjup.note: Fairway depth, not maximum permitted vessel draught.

slussar_planerad_drift.name: Planned commissioning of new locks
slussar_planerad_drift.note: June 2026 schedule: around 2034. Earlier 2030 dates are not the current plan.

klimatmal_geografiskt.name: Target reduction in territorial CO2 emissions
klimatmal_geografiskt.note: Policy target: reduction from 2022 to 2030, not an observed outcome.

klimatmal_konsumtion.name: Target per-capita consumption emissions
klimatmal_konsumtion.note: Consumption target; separate from territorial emissions.

klimatmal_nettonoll.name: Net-zero target year
klimatmal_nettonoll.note: By 2045 according to the municipal long-term target.
